title: Dehumidifier Grade for Open Wall Cavities in Water Damage Mitigation Drying
content:
Water Damage Mitigation equipment selection note. Dehumidifier capacity follows the IICRC class and the open cavities: on a Class 4 job carrying flood cut lines the dehumidifier daily rate at which the drying estimate prices its dehumidifiers is the tier's desiccant dehumidifier daily rate, on a Class 3 job carrying flood cut lines it is the tier's large-capacity XL LGR dehumidifier daily rate, and on any other job no capacity upgrade applies.

The class is the IICRC class on the job record; the flood cut lines are the job's own charge lines; the daily rates are those of the job's tier.

## Selection table
| IICRC class | Flood cut lines on the job | Dehumidifier daily rate selected |
|---|---|---|
| Class 4 | yes | the tier's desiccant dehumidifier daily rate |
| Class 3 | yes | the tier's XL LGR dehumidifier daily rate |
| Class 3 or Class 4 | no | no capacity upgrade |
| Class 1 or Class 2 | any | no capacity upgrade |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A slab-on-grade Class 4 job with walls opened by flood cuts prices its dehumidifiers at the tier's desiccant rate; the same job before any flood cut line is booked carries no capacity upgrade.
